body:
ggml-cpu : keep the FP16->FP32 lookup table on x86 with F16C ( #30342 ) ( #30343 )

- ggml-cpu : keep the FP16->FP32 lookup table on x86 with F16C ( #30342 )

#30270 routed both scalar conversions through F16C. For FP16->FP32, Clang 20.1.8

lowers the intrinsic to a vpinsrw merging into the live accumulator register of

the quantized dot products, which serialises the loop (19 vs 4 cycles/iteration

estimated, 45-65% slower Q8_0/Q4_0 MUL_MAT_ID kernels measured). Keep F16C for

FP32->FP16 as intended and the table for FP16->FP32.

- ggml-cpu : comment out the F16C FP16->FP32 define instead of removing it (review)

summaryZh: llama.cpp发布b11635版本，针对x86架构优化了ggml-cpu转换逻辑。此前版本由于F16C内联函数导致量化点积循环串行化并引发45-65%的性能下降，本次更新保留了FP16转FP32的查找表以恢复CPU推理性能。
